messages:
Maya (People Ops): Quick announcement: we've published an update to the Emergency Leave & Mental Health Support section of the handbook. New items: a short-term emergency leave (up to 4 weeks) process, an optional manager check-in cadence for returns, and a mandatory manager ack for the policy changes. Read: https://redwood.hr/handbook/emergency-leave. Please complete the manager acknowledgement by Tue 09/15.

Sam (Eng Manager): Thanks Maya. Is the 4-week short-term leave paid or unpaid?

Maya (People Ops): Short-term emergency leave is paid at 50% base pay by default; teams can top-up from discretionary manager funds (budget permitting). We've outlined sign-off steps and return-to-work check-in guidance in the doc.

Priya (Manager): For sensitive medical details, what goes into the HR notes vs manager notes? Need clarity for confidentiality.

Jordan (People Ops): Good point. Health details go only to People Ops and Benefits. Manager notes should be limited to return-to-work accommodations and expected timeline. The ack form includes a checkbox confirming you reviewed the confidentiality guidance.

training-bot: Microcourse published: "Managing leaves & supportive return-to-work" (12 min) -> https://learn.redwood.com/courses/leaves-return. Completion will auto-fill the manager ack fields.

Liam (People Manager): If an IC takes intermittent short leaves over several months (e.g., recurring appointments), do we roll them into the 4-week bucket or treat per-instance?

Maya (People Ops): Use the 4-week bucket as a rolling 90-day window. If intermittent appointments total more than 4 weeks in a 90-day period, escalate to People Ops for review of longer-term options.

Sam (Eng Manager): Is there a CSV template for bulk acks? I manage multiple small teams.

Jordan (People Ops): Yes. Template columns: email,manager_id,team,leave_flag (none/short-term/intermittent),ack_submitted,notes. Drop CSV here or upload to s3://redwood-ops/exports/2026/09/leaves-2523456789.csv and we'll ingest. Example local command:
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-ops/exports/2026/09/leaves-2523456789.csv ./ && csvcut -c email,manager_id,leave_flag,ack_submitted,notes leaves-2523456789.csv > for-people-ops.csv

Priya (Manager): I'll run the microcourse and upload the CSV by Monday. One edge case: contractor with medical appointments — are contractors eligible for the short-term leave?

Maya (People Ops): Contractors are not eligible for paid short-term emergency leave. We recommend listing them as "intermittent" in the CSV and coordinating schedule flexibility with Talent. Exceptions can be reviewed case-by-case by People Ops + Talent.

Sam (Eng Manager): Submitted CSV and completed microcourse. Ack confirmation: ACK-2026-L-3391. Left notes on one intermittent case.

Maya (People Ops): Got it, thanks. Office hours Fri 10am PT to walk through privacy questions and the CSV format: https://meet.redwood.com/people-ops/leaves-dropin (recorded). We'll run the compliance report after the deadline and follow up on rows requiring manual review.
thread_text_preview: Maya: handbook update - emergency leave & mental health support. 4-week paid short-term leave (50% pay), manager ack due Tue 09/15. Microcourse + CSV template + office hours posted.
